name: Woody House
detail: I had a wonderful four nights in Wan Chai. The location is excellent, with a great view outside the window. Just a short walk through a bustling street leads to Wan Chai Station (and even closer is the tram line), making it very convenient to get anywhere. The staff were always warm and attentive to my needs, and I could enjoy a clean environment every day, which felt great. The room had high-speed internet, and I was working during my stay without any issues. The room size is average for Hong Kong Island, which is acceptable. The sound insulation is relatively good; travelers who are sensitive to noise might initially find the hum of the air conditioning a bit uncomfortable, but it doesn't affect sleep once you get used to it. Overall, it was very good, and the hot dogs offered in the lobby were also fantastic—don't miss out on trying them if you have the chance.

name: Burlington Hotel
detail: The accommodation is clean, the room is spacious, and the bathroom is large. There is a microwave, plates, cutlery, and cups. The power outlets are old-fashioned, but you can request an adaptor at the lobby. There are Thai restaurants in the area and a curry fried pork rice place with a long queue that is very delicious. The staff provides good service, and the soundproofing of the room is good.

name: Ramada Hong Kong Harbour View
detail: The transportation options and view were good, and the Wi-Fi and hot water were fine. On the downside, there was a distinctive smell typical of older buildings, and the bathroom was a bit small. The mattress was uncomfortable, and there were some stains on the cover. Also, the air conditioning was a bit loud.

name: Regala Skycity Hotel by Regal Hotels
detail: Hong Kong Regal Airport Hotel Stay Review (Approximately 500 words) This time, I chose the Regal Airport Hotel in Hong Kong for my layover, and the overall experience far exceeded my expectations. It is absolutely the ceiling of cost-performance ratio around the airport! The hotel opened in 2022, featuring a modern and spacious design. The lobby, with marble accents and soft lighting, is open and tidy. The check-in process was smooth, and the front desk staff were gentle and patient. Communication throughout was unobstructed, and they kindly informed me of the free shuttle bus schedule. The geographical location is the biggest highlight, just a few minutes' drive from Hong Kong Airport. The hotel offers a free shuttle bus that runs regularly between the airport, Tung Chung MTR Station, and Disneyland. It's only a two to three-minute walk to the AsiaWorld-Expo, making it particularly convenient for attending concerts, catching early flights, or family outings, saving on expensive taxi costs. It's within walking distance to the 11 SKIES shopping mall, providing a one-stop solution for dining and shopping, maximizing travel convenience. The guest rooms are clean and bright, considerably more spacious compared to hotels in downtown Hong Kong at the same price point. The entire building features double-glazed soundproof windows, so even being close to the airport, there is no noise from planes taking off and landing, allowing for a very restful sleep. The bedding is soft and skin-friendly, and the toiletries are fully equipped. There are drinking water machines in the corridors, so you can bring your own cup to fill up, which is both environmentally friendly and convenient. The floor-to-ceiling windows offer a wide view; in some room types, you can watch the planes take off and land from the bed. The rooftop observation deck allows for enjoying sea views and sunsets in the evening, perfect for capturing the atmosphere in photos. The hotel has comprehensive facilities, with a 24-hour gym and an outdoor heated swimming pool, providing leisure options for families as well. The buffet breakfast is rich in variety, offering a complete range of both Western and Chinese food.

name: Dorsett Wanchai Hong Kong
detail: I stayed for two days in a 58 square meter connecting room for family use. The facilities were cleaner than I expected, and I noticed a lot of Western tourists. It's a bit of a walk from the station, but the area is safe, so it wasn't a big deal. It takes nearly 10 minutes to walk to the nearby supermarket and convenience store, but it's easy if it's not raining. The toilet in the room got clogged, but they came to repair it right away, and even when the breaker fell due to a lack of a transformer, they promptly sent someone to fix it. Breakfast included eggs benedict and steamed buns, which were around 50 points. Not bad at all. There is an airport bus, and many taxis pass by in front of the hotel, making it convenient. You can see horse races from the room, and it's a lovely hotel. I would like to use it again.

name: L'etoile Hella Inn
detail: This accommodation offers excellent value for money, with a convenient location surrounded by many dining and attractions. Self-check-in is available at 3 PM, and self-check-out before 12 PM. The rooms are clean and tidy, with complete facilities that can meet various needs. The staff's service is warm and attentive, making guests feel at home. Overall, this is an ideal choice and highly recommended for anyone seeking comfort and convenience.

name: Mini Central
detail: There are good and bad points to this accommodation!! The towels are disposable.... I've never used them in my 38 years Soundproofing is poor, I can hear everything from the neighboring room The room is small, there's no space for luggage The bathroom sink is too small to wash my face properly Hot water comes out well, the air conditioning works well, and there are plenty of electrical outlets The location and cost-effectiveness are good, close to the subway station, and the staff is present 24 hours, so even though I arrived at 2 AM, they checked me in smoothly!

name: Sleep Cubee Hostel
detail: The overall experience of this solo trip was great. The room was clean and quiet, and the public areas were well-maintained. The surrounding area was convenient for travel, and public transportation was very accessible. The soundproofing of the accommodation was good, allowing for a peaceful night's rest. The host responded promptly, and for future trips, I will prioritize booking through this platform. I recommend it for solo travelers.

name: Check Inn HK
detail: First of all, due to the typhoon in the early morning, my flight was delayed and I arrived at the accommodation around 3 AM. When I contacted the owner via WhatsApp, they arrived in just a few minutes to assist with the check-in. If no one had come at that time, I might have fallen asleep on the sofa in the hostel's living room lol. The location is right in the heart of Hong Kong, so I didn't feel any inconvenience going anywhere. However, perhaps due to the characteristics of the buildings in Hong Kong being old, the bathroom was very small, and a cockroach appeared once. But this too became a memory, as the brother from the floor below caught it for me ^^. Given the price and location, I see no reason not to recommend it.

name: Bishop Lei International House
detail: Came to Hong Kong for business meetings and stayed in a luxurious suite at the hotel. The room is fully equipped with a desk for work and an area for meetings. The hotel is located on Robinson Road in Mid-Levels, with a view of Central outside the window that offers a pleasant night scene. The front desk staff is very friendly, providing clear and complete information. The daily cleaning service is meticulous and thorough. I will choose this hotel again for my next business trip.
